newsitem.title: UK: UK extends Entergy/London Elec review.
newsitem.headline: UK extends Entergy/London Elec review.

text.p: The UK's director general of fair trading said on Tuesday he had extended the period for consideration of the proposed acquisition by Entergy Power UK Plc of regional electricity company London Electricity Plc.
The director said in a statement he had extended the period for a further 15 working days and the time for considering the acquisition would now end on February 10.

The 1.267 billion stg bid by U.S.-based Entergy Corp was launched on December 18 with a recommendation from London Electricity's board. The Office of Fair Trading was originally due to have considered the bid by January 20.
The OFT advises the trade and industry secretary Ian Lang on whether bids should be referred to the Monopolies and Mergers Commission (MMC).

The Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) recently cleared two other bids for regional electricity companies from U.S. firms, that of Dominion Resources for East Midlands Electricity and by CE Electric for Northern Electric.
